description: This file is a shell script intended for testing git diff functionalities under various scenarios, including relative path specifications, configuration options, and external diff tool integrations. It defines multiple testing functions and executes a sequence of git commands to verify diff outputs.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Function to verify diff output against an expected pattern using git diff -p.

methods.name: check_diff_relative_option
methods.description: Function to verify diff output with a specific --relative configuration.

methods.name: check_diff_no_relative_option
methods.description: Function to verify diff output with no --relative option, even when config is set.
